_om: Smilefjeset in English (Chuffed, rusj.no/en/chuffed/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A «gåte» is an emoji riddle; «Gjengen» is playing as a group, «Alene» on your own. The riddles are in data.en/gater.json, written for the UK.
Noen få emojier skjuler et ordtak, en ti: A few emojis hide a saying, a thing, a place, an animal, a job or a well-known song. What do they say?
Én holder mobilen så alle ser kortet. Le: One person holds the phone so everyone can see the card. Read the emojis like a rebus – often it’s two words put together.
Den første som sier riktig svar, får poe: The first to say the right answer gets the point. Stuck? Tap ‘Hint’ – first you get the number of letters, then the first letters.
Trykk «Vis svaret» og så på den som gjet: Tap ‘Show the answer’ and then whoever guessed first. After 10 or 20 riddles come the results.
Alene? Velg «Alene» og si ærlig om du kl: On your own? Choose ‘Solo’ and be honest about whether you got it. The phone remembers your record.
Hint koster ingenting. Bruk dem når de m: Hints are free. Use them when little ones are playing.
Ord som ligner, teller: «snømann» og «sn: Close enough counts: ‘snowman’ and ‘snowmen’ are both fine.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar poenget tilbak: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the point back.
Swipe the card away for a new riddle.
Etter {n} gåter ser du hvor mange du kla: After {n} riddles you’ll see how many you got.
Etter {n} gåter kommer kåringen av seg s: After {n} riddles the results come up by themselves.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Alle gjetter – først riktig får poenget: Everyone guesses – first right answer wins the point
Gjett selv og slå rekorden din: Guess on your own and beat your record
Every single one! You really are chuffed.
Well done! You read emojis like a book.
Noen satt langt inne. Prøv igjen – de bl: Some were tricky. Try again – they get easier once you know the tricks.
Well done! Quickest at reading the emojis.
Emojiene vant denne gangen. Prøv med hin: The emojis won this time. Try the hints!
You’ll see how many you’ve got so far.
You’ll go straight to the results.
Jeg klarte {riktig} av {av} emoji-gåter: I got {riktig} of {av} emoji riddles in {spill}. Can you beat me? 😄
